brief:
Israel censors Palestinian school textbooks and curricula to suppress instruction on Palestinian national consciousness, according to Al Jazeera English. The occupation authorities view education emphasizing Palestinian identity and history as a threat to their control and have moved to limit what can be taught in Palestinian schools.

The restrictions target material that builds national awareness among Palestinian students, reflecting broader efforts by Israeli authorities to shape the educational environment under occupation.
dek: The occupation authorities are trying to censor Palestinian school curricula because they teach national consciousness.
title: Israel restricts Palestinian school curricula on national identity
